profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Best Lawyers

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed software solutions by studying business needs; studied systems flow, data usage, and work processes; investigated problem areas; followed the software development life cycle.
•	Diagnosed errors in complex software and system issues; drive root cause understanding and implemented corrective actions; provided timely communications back to business.
•	Upgraded, migrated, and mavenized applications from Websphere Application Server V8.5 to Websphere Application Server V9/Websphere Application Server Liberty; upgraded application from Angular 5 to Angular 8.

positions.title: Process Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Assisted with the setup and design of new and existing SharePoint sites throughout the company.
•	Worked with end users to resolve issues with their SharePoint sites and inform users on best practices and site management using Office 365 products.
•	Developed wireframes and prototypes of proposed designs for Process Engineering solutions.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
•	Provide review of Certificates of Calibration, letters, and other related documents. Update any changes when equipment has been purchased, retired, or inactivated.
•	Regular logging of details for re-calibrated equipment onto database system, IndySoft, and set up service/calibration schedules.
•	Communicate with third parties to organize the sending of equipment for service, repair, and re-certification.

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
•	Installed and configured computer applications and operating systems. Provided technical support, including procedural documentation and relevant reports. Follow documentation and diagrams to repair or set up systems.
•	Collaborated with a team of IT professionals to set specifications for new application features. Understand client requirements and developed technical documents to represent application design and workflow.
•	Assisted company with the implementation of Disaster Recovery Plan by transferring to temporary location and setting up 200 work stations.

positions.title: Electronic Medical Records Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Conducted performance tests as necessary. Revised existing systems and procedures to correct problems and maintains effective data handling, conversion, and storage. 
•	Recognized, identified, and documented potential areas where existing process require change, or where new processes need to be developed and make recommendations in these areas.
•	Designed, implemented and maintained 20 user-friendly templates within the PrognoCIS system.
•	Implemented the transition from ICD-9-CM to ICD-10-CM.

positions.title: Durable Medical Equipment Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Provided education to over 100 patients on the application, use, and care for durable medical equipment products as indicated by the provider’s instruction. Educated patients on insurance plans, financial responsibility, and collection of patient portion.
•	Performed patient scheduling, confirmation, order processing, insurance authorization, and billing. Collected $11,000 from processed claims.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Educated over 600 individuals, local communities, organizations, and agencies on how to prevent, prepare, for and respond to disasters/emergencies 

Tracked and input survey and demographic event feedback  

Developed real time electronic input method for survey and demographic records

Prepared and filed documentation related to Red Cross provided services and recorded data into electronic client database 

Worked with specially trained volunteers to determine a client’s immediate disaster-related needs and assisted with client follow up
